notes.title: Recorded ink colors
notes.text: The stored visual survey classifies 13 rune regions as red and 249 as dark. These are measurements of the reviewed image regions, not interpretations of the colors.

notes.title: Oversized opening rune
notes.text: The opening S rune extends alongside the first three text rows. Its rectangle is recorded separately from the ordinary first-row glyphs.

notes.title: Punctuation measurements
notes.text: The 58 stored punctuation regions contain 56 regions with 1 connected component, 1 region with 4 connected components, 1 region with 13 connected components. 2 punctuation regions are classified red. Components are thresholded pixel groups, not a linguistic interpretation. Recounted within the stored rectangles on 19 October 2026.
